name: event_date
description: UTC calendar date of the archive operation — the BigQuery partition key (Doc 07B §5.3 / §13). The 730-day partition expiration runs from this. Written by archiveRows() as DATE(_archived_at); see ARCHIVE_PARTITION_FIELD in server/services/retention-archive.ts

name: _archived_at
description: ISO timestamp of the archive operation (set by retention sweep)

name: _source_table
description: Supabase source table name (provenance for dedup at query time)
